# media-session

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The browser's media session for music played through Web Audio: useMediaSession({ title, artist, artwork, playing, position, actions }) lists the caller's music in Chrome's media controls and the OS's Now Playing / media keys — a detached, looping, near-silent <audio> keeps the session open (Chrome lists only pages a media element plays in) while navigator.mediaSession carries the metadata, play state, scrubber position and action handlers. One session per page: the claim that most recently started playing owns it, the previous taking it back when it goes.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.useAssetSrcs`
    - `primitives/dom/media-element.playMedia`
    - `primitives/latest-ref.useLatestRef`
  - Exports (types):
    - `MediaArtwork`
    - `MediaPosition`
    - `MediaSessionActions`
    - `MediaSessionClaim`
  - Exports (values): `useMediaSession`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/sonata/now-playing`
    - `music/background`
